directions.en: From Eagle Square, move straight past NNPC Towers.
directions.ha: Daga Eagle Square, ka wuce NNPC Towers kai tsaye.

directions.en: From Sheraton Hotel, turn towards Silverbird. The curved road is Aminu Kano Crescent.
directions.ha: Daga Sheraton Hotel, juya zuwa Silverbird. Hanyar da ke lankwashewa ita ce Aminu Kano Crescent.

directions.en: From Transcorp Hilton, take the road beside the old NITEL building — Gana Street.
directions.ha: Daga Transcorp Hilton, ka bi hanyar gefen tsohon ginin NITEL, Gana Street ce.

directions.en: From Millennium Park, move towards Maitama Bridge. The road connecting them is Herbert Macaulay Way.
directions.ha: Daga Millennium Park, ka nufi Maitama Bridge. Hanyar haɗin su ita ce Herbert Macaulay Way.

directions.en: From National Mosque, continue past the Secretariat — that is Tafawa Balewa Way.
directions.ha: Daga Babban Masallacin Kasa, ka wuce Secretariat, wannan Tafawa Balewa Way ce.

directions.en: From Transcorp Hilton, enter the embassy district — Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent.
directions.ha: Daga Transcorp Hilton, shiga yankin ofisoshin jakadanci, Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent.

directions.en: From City Gate, drive towards Area 1. The long express road is Olu Obasanjo Way.
directions.ha: Daga City Gate, ka nufi Area 1. Doguwar babbar hanya ita ce Olu Obasanjo Way.

directions.en: From Airport Road, continue straight into the city — Nnamdi Azikiwe Expressway.
directions.ha: Daga Airport Road, ka ci gaba kai tsaye zuwa gari, Nnamdi Azikiwe Expressway.

directions.en: From Central Bank, drive towards National Assembly — Independence Avenue.
directions.ha: Daga Babban Bankin Kasa, ka nufi National Assembly, Independence Avenue.
